description: GAIA style (offline file question, read-only): combine a CSV export, a text-extracted PDF report and an operations note. The report defines Q1, per-product pallet capacities and a per product and month round-up rule; the note removes a duplicated row and says one figure is in dozens. Skipping the note, counting April, or rounding the total instead of each group gives a different number than the exact final answer.
